EVIDENCE and superseded USER facts do not confirm current user inputs.
Unknown plan question names remain rejected.
Canonical Streamlit version question and existing source gap behavior stay unchanged.
forbidden_inputs: Held-out case inputs, gold, review artifacts or manifests
